promptTemplate:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: CitySim fixed-camera 2.5D commercial building source sprite
Primary request: Create one unique authored commercial building sprite for logical identity __IDENTITY__.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable CitySim style anchor; Image 2 is the immutable registration/calibration appearance reference; Image 3 is the immutable ground-pivot registration template. Use them only as style, projection, scale, and registration references.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat uniform solid #ff00ff chroma-key field, no floor plane and no environmental scene.
Subject: one centered commercial building only, fully contained with generous empty padding, matching the identity brief exactly.
Style/medium: richly detailed realistic hand-painted city-builder illustration with a fixed orthographic 2:1 isometric 2.5D presentation; not voxel, toy-like, flat-vector, or raw 3D-render appearance.
Composition/framing: authoring canvas 1536 x 1024; single canonical angle; orthographic 2:1 isometric view; centered building; ground pivot reference at [768, 896]; generous transparent-ready padding; contained southeast contact/cast shadow; northwest key light.
Lighting/mood: clear daylight, northwest light, soft but readable southeast shadow contained under the building.
Color palette: cohesive CitySim commercial palette with material contrast and readable facade hierarchy; no neon chroma except the background.
Materials/textures: believable masonry, glass, metal, wood, roof, trim, and subtle surface variation appropriate to the identity brief.
Text (verbatim): ""
Constraints: one building, one logical identity, unique massing and silhouette; preserve the fixed camera and registration; keep all subject pixels away from the frame edges; no road, parcel, sidewalk, district, trees, cars, pedestrians, props, extra buildings, labels, signs, logos, UI, selection marks, warnings, coordinates, gameplay state, watermark, frame, reflection, perspective convergence, rotation, mirroring, or alternate directions.
Avoid: cropped subject or shadow, visible magenta spill inside the building, baked geometry guides, text, branding, duplicate structures, aliasing another identity.
